notes: The subject begins with three adapter-configured application attributes published on its object class, then unpublishes that entire application set through IEEE 1516.1-2025. The requester checks a fresh IEEE 1516.2-2025 HLAreportObjectClassPublication NULL response: one count parameter set to zero, with no object-class or attribute-list parameters, as prescribed when no object classes contain attributes published by the federate. The MIM defines both the inherited HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject attribute and the report/NULL-response semantics. No DDM services are used.

requirements.statement: The federate unpublishes the complete adapter-configured application attribute set through the standard Unpublish Object Class Attributes service. A new standard publication query then reflects the resulting declaration state.

After all adapter-configured application attributes are unpublished, no object class contains attributes published by the federate. The publication query therefore returns the exact MIM NULL response: zero classes and omitted object-class and attribute-list parameters.
